caption_topic: Coupling-strength stress table
notes: Long format, 50 rows: 5 beta_sp values x 10 (arm, mode) rows. Every explicit arm is measured in BOTH modes: substep_mode=one-step (exactly one step per macro-step, the CFL-violating regime, substeps_per_macro=1.00) and substep_mode=auto (the arm's own coupling-resolution controller, tol=0.02, substeps_per_macro 1.96/15.60/30.33/59.81/118.73). M3 is always one-step: cons_resid <= 6.57e-14, neg_S=neg_I=0, all_finite=True at every beta_sp. EXP2-midpoint is status=closed_form_undefined for beta_sp>=15 (its closed-form allocation needs sigma>Lambda); it is reported with NaN, never repaired.

caption_topic: Positivity-treatment comparison
notes: 10 rows: beta_sp in {1.153846, 60} x {M3 one-step, clip one-step, untreated one-step, clip auto, untreated auto}; substeps_per_macro is a column so that 'no projection' and 'no subcycling' are never confounded.
